_comment: Promotion quests are class-gated and data-driven. defeat_enemy objective behaviour is implemented once by QuestManager; quest-specific ids and values live only here.

quests.name: Trial of the Dawn
quests.description: Face the darkness beneath the shrine and return with your oath intact.

quests.name: The Silent Contract
quests.description: Prove that even the shrine's unseen warden can be reached.

quests.name: The Unwritten Page
quests.description: Defeat the keeper below the shrine and record what waits beyond it.

quests.name: The Last Bastion
quests.description: Break the shrine's guardian twice and show that endurance can become victory.

quests.name: The Moonless Night
quests.description: Hunt the thing below the shrine until the dark itself learns caution.

quests.name: The Hollow Crown
quests.description: Unmake the shrine's warden twice and claim authority over what remains.

quests.name: The Final Oath
quests.description: Return to the deepest dark three times. Let each victory renew the vow.

quests.name: The Devouring Dark
quests.description: Feed the dark its own guardian until nothing remains but your shadow.

quests.name: The First Word
quests.description: Silence the shrine's answer three times and speak the word that remains.

quests.name: Ascension
quests.description: Overcome the last guardian five times. There is no witness left to name what follows.

quests.name: Roots That Remember
quests.description: Lethira asks you to cut silver thorns from the stalkers haunting her lost path.

quests.name: A Memory With Wings
quests.description: With Lethira beside you, follow the cold lanterns carrying pieces of her past.

quests.name: The Missing Resonance
quests.description: Brokk needs intact crystal shells to reconstruct an erased clan refrain.

quests.name: Where the Deep Song Broke
quests.description: Descend with Brokk and confront the delvers repeating his clan's stolen verse.

quests.name: A Debt Written in Briars
quests.description: Veyra's infernal creditor has hidden clauses inside the witches' living marks.

quests.name: No Signature Remains
quests.description: Veyra asks you to erase the acolytes still enforcing contracts in her name.

quests.name: The Oath's Missing Verbs
quests.description: Rhazek believes thunder drake scales preserve the burned words of his family oath.

quests.name: First Light, Last Guardian
quests.description: Carry Rhazek's restored oath into the cloud ruins and silence its ancient witnesses.

quests.name: A Practical Education
quests.description: Mara asks for proof that heroism includes listening, travelling, and carrying things.

quests.name: The Many Roads
quests.description: A human traveller asks you to deliver letters to three settlements, proving that humans belong everywhere.

quests.name: Songs of the Silver Wood
quests.description: Elder Amariel asks you to recover three lost elven songs from the depths of Mosswood.

quests.name: The Deep Roads
quests.description: Thane Dorrim sends you into the crystal mines to reopen a collapsed tunnel and recover a lost clan relic.

quests.name: The First Oath
quests.description: Keth Cloudscar asks you to honour the first dragonkin oath by defeating a thunder drake at the Obsidian Gate.

quests.name: The Ash Court Summons
quests.description: Mother Sable delivers a summons from the Ash Court. You must prove your worth or face the consequences.

quests.name: The Great Migration
quests.description: Siv Quickpaw asks you to scout the migration route and clear the path of threats.

quests.name: The Blood Debt
quests.description: Gruk Ironjaw tells you of a blood debt owed to his clan. You must defeat the bandits who wronged them.

quests.name: The War Song
quests.description: An orc elder asks you to prove your strength in the arena, earning the right to sing the war song.

quests.name: The Grand Invention
quests.description: Pip Sprocket needs rare components for a device that will revolutionise travel. Gather the parts!

quests.name: Controlled Demolition
quests.description: Pip's latest invention has gone haywire in the mines. Shut it down before it brings the ceiling down!

quests.name: The Great Pie Contest
quests.description: Rose Underhill challenges you to gather the finest ingredients for the annual halfling pie contest.

quests.name: The Uninvited Guest
quests.description: A halfling thief has stolen from the community. Track them down and recover the goods.

quests.name: Elemental Heritage
quests.description: Ember Skysong asks you to commune with the elemental planes at four sacred sites.

quests.name: The Storm Calling
quests.description: A genasi elder asks you to calm a raging elemental storm threatening Skyreach.

quests.name: The Mountain's Test
quests.description: Korrath Peaks challenges you to survive the mountain's trials — a test of endurance and will.

quests.name: The Reckoning
quests.description: Among goliaths, every deed is scored. Prove your worth by defeating the strongest foes in the land.

quests.name: The Lost Library
quests.description: Sythia Coils asks you to recover three ancient tomes from the Drowned Archive.

quests.name: The Serpent's Memory
quests.description: An ancient lamia asks you to visit the places where her kind once ruled, recovering lost history.

quests.name: Threads of Fate
quests.description: Nethys Websong asks you to gather silk from three ancient spider nests to weave a tapestry of prophecy.

quests.name: The Great Hunt
quests.description: An arachne elder challenges you to prove your hunting prowess by defeating the most dangerous prey.

quests.name: Welcome to Ironveil
quests.description: Commander Vex wants to test your worth before granting access to the city's inner sanctum.

quests.name: The Ashen Expedition
quests.description: Chronicler Thon needs someone to recover artifacts from the Ashen Wastes before they're lost forever.

quests.name: Heart of Cinder
quests.description: Artificer Zara needs a core sample from the deepest magma flow to power her latest invention.

quests.name: The Void Throne
quests.description: Commander Vex is assembling a strike force to assault the Void Throne. You are the tip of the spear.

quests.name: Secrets of the Sunken Citadel
quests.description: Chronicler Thon believes the Sunken Citadel holds records of the first war against the void.

quests.name: Trial of the Void Reaver
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Shadow Reaver to Void Reaver by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Aegis Bastion
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Iron Bastion to Aegis Bastion by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Tempest Sovereign
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Stormblade to Tempest Sovereign by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Phantasm Lord
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Illusionist to Phantasm Lord by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Aeon Weaver
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Time Weaver to Aeon Weaver by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Death Sovereign
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Lich Lord to Death Sovereign by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Crimson Sovereign
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Bloodlord to Crimson Sovereign by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Blood Tyrant
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Blood Sovereign to Blood Tyrant by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Horde Sovereign
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Horde Lord to Horde Sovereign by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Grand Marshal
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Supreme Commander to Grand Marshal by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Sovereign Strategist
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Grand Strategist to Sovereign Strategist by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Drake Lord
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Cavalry Lord to Drake Lord by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Elder Warden
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Trail Warden to Elder Warden by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Apex Predator
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Alpha Predator to Apex Predator by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Godseye
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Deadeye to Godseye by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Specter Lord
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Wraith Lord to Specter Lord by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Abyss Walker
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Void Walker to Abyss Walker by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Annihilator
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Demolitionist to Annihilator by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Divine Avatar
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Divine Oracle to Divine Avatar by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Absolute Purifier
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Purifier to Absolute Purifier by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Loom Master
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Fate Weaver to Loom Master by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Infernal Sovereign
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Archfiend to Infernal Sovereign by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Oblivion Blade
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Doom Blade to Oblivion Blade by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Trial of the Death Reaper
quests.description: Prove worth to ascend from Soul Reaper to Death Reaper by defeating the guardians of ascension.

quests.name: Rook's Mercenary Contract
quests.description: Rook seeks to settle an old score with a bandit syndicate operating near Ashvale.

quests.name: Kess's Elven Heritage
quests.description: Help Kess recover an ancient elven heirloom lost in the Whispering Woods.

quests.name: The Open Road
quests.description: Mara asks you to learn what ordinary people on the road need before deciding what being human means to you.

quests.name: The Common Accord
quests.description: At the old milestones, choose whether your heritage is defined by community or self-reliance.

quests.name: A Thousand Voices
quests.description: Return to an ancient shrine and bind the many lessons of humanity into a single deliberate path.

quests.name: The First Star
quests.description: Elder Amariel sends you to recover a fragment of the song that once guided elven travellers through living woods.

quests.name: The Memory Grove
quests.description: In the drowned archive, decide whether memory must be preserved exactly or allowed to change with the living.

quests.name: The Song Beyond
quests.description: Sing the recovered fragment beneath the cloud ruins and let it become more than an echo of the past.

quests.name: Two Lanterns
quests.description: Scholar Iven asks you to collect stories from the road where both sides of a divided family once travelled.

quests.name: The Bridge Unchosen
quests.description: At Emberwatch’s old bridge, choose whether you honour inheritance or build a third path between it.

quests.name: A Name of Your Own
quests.description: At the cloud ruins, speak the name you have chosen for yourself into the open sky.

quests.name: The Sleeping Vein
quests.description: Thane Dorrim hears a buried vein singing beneath the mines and asks you to prove it is not a warning.

quests.name: The Hammer's Measure
quests.description: At the Red Pass forge-stones, choose whether tradition or invention should shape the next generation of craft.

quests.name: Hall of the First Forge
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, awaken the memory of the first forge without repeating its oldest mistakes.

quests.name: Ember of the First Scale
quests.description: Keth sends you to the storm plateau to recover proof that dragonkin blood is more than a claim of old power.

quests.name: The Oath Reforged
quests.description: Among the cloud ruins, choose whether your draconic oath is service to a brood or mastery of yourself.

quests.name: The Skybound Crown
quests.description: Face the Obsidian Gate and turn inherited pride into an oath you can actually uphold.

quests.name: Ashes of the Blood Court
quests.description: Mother Sable asks you to recover a sealed ash-token before the marsh consumes its last witness.

quests.name: The Price of Fire
quests.description: At the drowned archive, choose whether infernal power is a debt to collect or a burden to carry.

quests.name: The Unburning Name
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, strip an inherited title of its power and decide what remains beneath it.

quests.name: The Inherited Spark
quests.description: Pell needs a fragment from the Sunken Shrine to prove your planar blood can be studied without being exploited.

quests.name: A Pact Rewritten
quests.description: At the glassmarsh mirrors, choose whether to amend your inherited pact or leave every promise unanswered.

quests.name: The Door Between
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, close the door others opened in your name—or walk through it on your own terms.

quests.name: The Scent of Home
quests.description: Siv asks you to follow an old migration scent through Mosswood before it is lost beneath new roads.

quests.name: The Pack's Promise
quests.description: In the Glassmarsh, choose whether your instincts are strongest in a pack or in the freedom to roam alone.

quests.name: The Unfenced Wild
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, claim a wild path that no fence, banner, or hunter can close.

quests.name: The Old Debt
quests.description: Thrakk asks you to settle a road debt without letting outsiders decide what honour means for an orc.

quests.name: The War Song Choice
quests.description: At the Red Pass, choose whether your war song belongs to conquest or protection.

quests.name: The Banner Without Chains
quests.description: Raise a banner at the Obsidian Gate that carries strength without repeating old chains.

quests.name: The Broken Wonder
quests.description: Cogsworth needs a live crystal resonance from the mines to rebuild an invention that once saved a village.

quests.name: The Responsible Spark
quests.description: On the storm plateau, choose whether a dangerous invention should be shared freely or safeguarded.

quests.name: The Impossible Device
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, assemble a device everyone calls impossible and prove them delightfully wrong.

quests.name: The Long Table
quests.description: Butterbur asks you to make a difficult road safe enough that travellers can share a meal without fear.

quests.name: A Lucky Turn
quests.description: At Emberwatch, choose whether luck is something to hoard or something made by helping others.

quests.name: The Road Home
quests.description: At the cloud ruins, set a table for strangers and prove that home can travel with you.

quests.name: The Element Remembers
quests.description: Zephyr asks you to read the elemental scars left across the storm plateau before rival powers exploit them.

quests.name: The Shape of the Storm
quests.description: At the cloud ruins, choose whether an element is mastered through control or through surrender to its nature.

quests.name: The Confluence
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, let every element in your blood meet without one consuming the others.

quests.name: A Stone's Witness
quests.description: Granite Heart asks you to carry a witness-stone through the Red Pass and return with its story intact.

quests.name: The Weight You Carry
quests.description: In the Singing Mines, choose whether your strength is measured by burdens carried alone or shared with others.

quests.name: The Peak Within
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, stand beneath a weight no one else can lift and discover the peak inside yourself.

quests.name: The First Coil
quests.description: Ophidia asks you to recover a scale-inscription from the Sunken Shrine before grave-robbers turn it into a weapon.

quests.name: Memory or Mercy
quests.description: At the Drowned Archive, choose whether ancient memory should judge the living or teach them mercy.

quests.name: The Serpent's Crown
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, claim a crown of memory without allowing it to close around your throat.

quests.name: The Uncut Thread
quests.description: Spinner asks you to recover a lost thread from the Mosswood before another weaver turns it into a snare.

quests.name: The Pattern Chosen
quests.description: At the Glassmarsh reflections, choose whether fate is a pattern to preserve or a thread to cut.

quests.name: The Loom of Tomorrow
quests.description: At the Obsidian Gate, weave one final thread into a future that remains yours to change.
